metodo: Somente GET publicos, sem segredo, a partir de uma estacao de trabalho (curl): /.well-known/build-info.json, /.well-known/runtime-info.json, ops?action=health (nao autenticado), health publico do webhook Warmbly e as tres rotas de captura do protocolo. Nenhum ssh, nenhum formulario enviado, nenhum e-mail enviado, nenhuma sonda, nenhuma escrita em store, Warmbly ou Resend. Os itens que exigem o host (Resend, contadores do ops autenticado, systemd, psql do Warmbly, env do runtime) ficam marcados INDISPONIVEL_SEM_SSH com o comando exato a executar ANTES do primeiro envio do QA; o protocolo g03-qa-protocolo.md le esses 'valores anteriores' no host, nunca deste arquivo.

1_resend_dominio.comando: ssh ec-prod 'set -a; . /etc/confenge-web/runtime.env; set +a; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RESEND_API_KEY" https://api.resend.com/domains/a75ceeb3-52aa-4ae6-8f9c-26f3d82489ea | jq "{name,status,region,records:[.records[]|{record,type,name,status}]}"'

inbound_handoff.comando: ssh ec-prod 'set -a; . /etc/confenge-web/runtime.env; set +a; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:18100/.netlify/functions/ops?action=inbound_handoff" | jq "{counters,configuration,safety_gate}"'
inbound_handoff.uso: valor anterior de counters.persisted_leads e counters.delivered para o §3.2 do protocolo; ler imediatamente antes do envio A

leads.comando: ssh ec-prod 'set -a; . /etc/confenge-web/runtime.env; set +a; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:18100/.netlify/functions/ops?action=leads&kind=real&pii=0" | jq "{count,sla_breaches,counts_by_kind,delivery_email:[.leads[].delivery.email]|group_by(.)|map({key:.[0],n:length})}"'
leads.uso: valor anterior de count e counts_by_kind.real/synthetic para o §3.6 do protocolo; lista leads reais com delivery.email error/pending (alerta real_leads_email_stale do scheduled_daily)
leads.nota: A projecao pii=0 de action=lead ja devolve delivery.email_provider_id/email_http/email_reason/email_idempotency_key (lead-stages.cjs publicDeliveryProjection, commit 505c833ab, contido em fedb4768b); o protocolo nao usa pii=1.

drain_inbound_email_reconcile_required.comando: ssh ec-prod 'set -a; . /etc/confenge-web/runtime.env; set +a; curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"limit\":20}" "http://127.0.0.1:18100/.netlify/functions/ops?action=drain_inbound" | jq "{ok,attempted,delivered,email_attempted,email_delivered,email_reconcile_required,reconcile_reasons:.email_retry.reconcile_reasons}"'
drain_inbound_email_reconcile_required.esperado: email_reconcile_required=0 (check critico do scheduled_daily desde esta campanha)

identidade_borda.prova: runtime-info.json e gerado pelo processo Node em execucao (nao e estatico); release_sha e public_artifact_hash iguais ao build-info servido pelo nginx provam que o runtime reiniciou na release fedb4768b.

systemd_confenge-web-runtime.comando: ssh ec-prod 'systemctl show confenge-web-runtime -p ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,NRestarts,ExecMainStartTimestamp; journalctl -u confenge-web-runtime -o short-iso -n 15 --no-pager'
systemd_confenge-web-runtime.esperado: active/running; ExecMainStartTimestamp (UTC) > 2026-09-19T19:54:34Z; journal sem erro; durable_store_failed=false

health_http://127.0.0.1:8080/health.comando: ssh ec-prod 'curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health; docker ps --format "{{.Names}} {{.Status}}" | grep warmbly-confenge'

outreach_inbound_leads_por_status.comando: ssh ec-prod "docker exec warmbly-confenge-postgres-1 psql -U warmbly -d warmbly_dev -At -F'|' -c \"select count(*), status from outreach_inbound_leads group by status order by status\""
outreach_inbound_leads_por_status.uso: valor anterior de OPEN/SUPPRESSED para o §3.6 do protocolo; ler imediatamente antes do envio A

identidade_qa.comando: ssh ec-prod "docker exec warmbly-confenge-postgres-1 psql -U warmbly -d warmbly_dev -At -c \"select count(*) from outreach_inbound_leads where lead_email = '<e-mail do QA, ver protocolo §0>'\""
identidade_qa.nota: Em 2026-09-18 o QA ainda nao tinha linhas; se o QA de 4cfa6adca chegou a ser executado, B1/C1 e os novos envios podem receber dedupe_of_lead_id dentro da janela de 24 h (inbound.go:16) — comportamento esperado, nao defeito.

5_env_runtime.comando: ssh ec-prod 'for k in LEAD_REQUIRE_TURNSTILE LEAD_REQUIRE_ORIGIN LEAD_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS RESEND_API_KEY OPS_TOKEN TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY CONFENGE_INBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET CONFENGE_INBOUND_WEBHOOK_URL LEAD_PROBE_SECRET LEAD_NOTIFY_EMAIL LEAD_FROM_EMAIL OPS_WEBHOOK_URL NTFY_URL; do if grep -q "^$k=." /etc/confenge-web/runtime.env; then echo "$k=SET"; else echo "$k=UNSET"; fi; done'
5_env_runtime.esperado: LEAD_REQUIRE_TURNSTILE=SET(1), LEAD_REQUIRE_ORIGIN=SET(1), RESEND_API_KEY=SET, OPS_TOKEN=SET, TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY=SET, CONFENGE_INBOUND_WEBHOOK_SECRET=SET, LEAD_PROBE_SECRET=SET, LEAD_NOTIFY_EMAIL=SET, LEAD_FROM_EMAIL=SET; LEAD_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS UNSET => 5000 ms (lead-delivery.cjs)
5_env_runtime.evidencia_publica_indireta: Turnstile obrigatorio e verificavel na borda: o slot #turnstile-slot esta nas tres rotas (item 6) e a automacao registrada em g03-qa-tentativa-automacao.json foi rejeitada em 4cfa6adca.
